headline: The US nuclear regulator has granted its second permit in six months to build a small modular reactor, this time for the Tennessee Valley Authority's Clinch River site.
score_reason: Permit was issued about 29 Sep 2026 (stale, lowered by 1); Industrial Info text unread.
importance_line: Tennessee Valley Authority customers could eventually gain a new power source, the reactor industry sees a faster licensing path, and the plant still needs a separate operating license and is years from running.
source: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy, as relayed by The Electrical Distributor
summary: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy said, in a release carried by The Electrical Distributor, that the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission issued the Tennessee Valley Authority a construction permit for a 300-megawatt BWRX-300 small modular reactor at Clinch River in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, the first such permit in the United States. The permit came about 29 Sep 2026, before today's window, and Industrial Info Resources' headline describes it as the second SMR permit in six months.
notes: Industrial Info page had no readable text; permit details from the company release on tedmag.com; Google News dates other outlets' coverage 28-30 Sep 2026.
